scope: Technical rereading and source checks, not full image-measurement replication

claims.objection_or_claim: Recovering illumination from a single perspective image is impossible
claims.finding: Correct point correspondences constrain a projected light direction. Physical lengths and a common receiving plane are unnecessary.
claims.source_locations: Dalleur pp31-39; Farid section5.7; Bradley response00:28-00:35,01:10-01:15

claims.finding: Known-source real photographs exist. They support applicability; they are not an independent D115 error distribution.

claims.objection_or_claim: Focal length, pitch and roll were ignored
claims.finding: Published sensitivity analysis and independent derivative check reproduce the intended factors.
Sufficient bounds can replace exact identity. Historical and visible-image constraints are relevant evidence.
claims.source_locations: Bradley response00:39-00:55; current Photo and Principles pages

claims.objection_or_claim: Vintage radial distortion explains the discrepancy
claims.finding: Low distortion has independent historical support. No actual D115 distortion model closing the gap was established. Full cue-by-cue propagation remains unreplicated.

claims.objection_or_claim: Bright-cloud rendering refutes the full D115 reconstruction
claims.finding: It illustrates a failure mode but does not fit all retained protected sharp cues together. The author supplies a specific reply.
Line incidence/collinearity is preserved; arbitrary Euclidean angles are not. The actual calibrated reconstruction performs the needed conversion.

claims.objection_or_claim: All unknown measurement errors already have an independently checked joint bound
claims.finding: Published feature illustrations and convergence matter, but no independently reselected6K endpoints/residual table/joint acceptance-region fit was completed here. This does not establish an error.
claims.source_locations: Dalleur Figs9-12; Muse reply section3; Bradley response01:15

claims.objection_or_claim: A black-and-white exposure independently measures instantaneous IR drying
claims.finding: The garment-related pattern can corroborate rain/drying testimony; water mass, time and infrared flux are not directly measured by one exposure.

claims.objection_or_claim: D115 principal numerical result fails arithmetic checking
claims.finding: Published inputs give28.2386067deg at37mm equivalent. Intended pitch/roll factors independently reproduce.

claims.objection_or_claim: Printed consistency corrections defeat the result
claims.finding: Equation9 intermediate roll term and an approximately0.01deg table mismatch do not change the base elevation. Magill angle correction still supports subpercent distortion.

claims.objection_or_claim: The period-photo validation promised in the video is completed evidence in that video
claims.finding: The video announces future work. The focused current search did not recover a newly completed matched historical validation dataset.

claims.objection_or_claim: Dalleur proposes two miraculous orbs invisible from the west
claims.finding: The second source is proposed as a bright cloud. The west-visibility discussion concerned a separate event.
